assertion: Twelve sugar pyruvate fermentation pathways and mixed acid fermentation are enriched in the duodenal microbiome of SIBO subjects (≥10³ CFU/mL on MAC) compared to non-SIBO (FC >1.1, adjusted P<.05). Aerobic cleavage of pyruvate is also enriched, including pyruvate to cytochrome bd/bo oxidase electron transfer (FC=1.48, adjusted P=2.09E-09). These pathways correlated with diarrhea (r=0.252, P=.0034), bloating (r=0.185, P=.025), urgency (r=0.205, P=.0146), and abdominal pain (r=0.300, P=.0006). Enterobacteriaceae species produce H₂ from sugar fermentation, and microbial reactions known to produce or consume H₂ are largely represented by pyruvate fermentation coupled with aerobic/anaerobic respiration.

qualifiers.magnitude: 12 sugar pyruvate fermentation pathways enriched (FC>1.1, P<.05); pyruvate→cytochrome bd/bo oxidase FC=1.48 (P=2.09E-09); succinate→cytochrome bd/bo oxidase FC=1.13 (P=.01); diarrhea r=0.252 P=.0034, bloating r=0.185 P=.025 (for pyruvate→electron transfer); bloating r=0.300 P=.0006, abdominal pain r=0.194 P=.0189 (for succinate→electron transfer)
qualifiers.conditions: duodenal aspirate; functional profiles from 16S and shotgun data via MetaCyc; SIBO ≥10³ CFU/mL on MAC
qualifiers.population: 505 adults (16S) and 38 subjects (shotgun) from REIMAGINE study
qualifiers.model: human prospective cross-sectional with predicted and measured functional profiling

provenance.ref: Leite et al. Defining Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth by Culture and High Throughput Sequencing
provenance.location: Results — Gas Production Pathways section, p.266
provenance.original_text: Twelve sugar pyruvate fermentation pathways were enriched in subjects with ≥10³ CFU/mL vs those with <10³ CFU/mL (FC, >1.1; adjusted P < .05), as was mixed acid fermentation (FC, 1.2; adjusted P = 2.18E-25). Aerobic cleavage of pyruvate was enriched in subjects with ≥10³ CFU/mL vs those with <10³ CFU/mL, including pyruvate to cytochrome bd/bo oxidase electron transfer (FC, 1.48; adjusted P = 2.09E-09), which correlated with diarrhea (Spearman r = 0.252; P = .0034), bloating (Spearman r = 0.185; P = .025), and urgency (Spearman r = 0.205; P = .0146)

integrity.coi_detail: Pimentel lab. 16S-based functional predictions confirmed by shotgun in subset (n=38).
integrity.methodology_note: Primary functional analysis from 16S predicted profiles (MetaCyc). Shotgun metagenomics (n=38) confirmed enrichment of sugar degradation, aerobic respiration, and pyruvate fermentation pathways, lending additional confidence.

chain_hints: KEY MECH: Establishes H2 production mechanism in SIBO — not just fermentation in general but specific pyruvate pathways
Supports breath hydrogen testing for SIBO by identifying the metabolic source of H2 in duodenal microbiome
Paper argues H2 derives from small intestine (not rapid transit to colon) — addresses longstanding debate
Connects to MECH-023 (H2S pathways in same subjects) — SIBO produces both H2 AND H2S via distinct pathway enrichment
Connects to BIO-025 (Enterobacteriaceae species driving these pathways)
Connects to existing fermentation guild erga (MECH-009/010 butyrate cross-feeding)
